emotional_tone: Monumental, Divine, Awe-inspiring, Cinematic, Ancient yet Modern

fonts.usage: H1, Hero titles, massive background text. Replaces standard Trajan/Cinzel for a more modern, less cliché Roman lapidary feel.
H2, H3, quotes, detail descriptions. Elegant, varied weight serif for narrative depth.
Paragraphs, navigation, buttons, small labels. Provides a clean, architectural geometric contrast.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Massive negative space, monumental asymmetry, brutalist grids.
layout_and_spacing.container: Max width screen, minimal horizontal padding (px-4 to px-12), letting 3D elements break the grid.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for the catalog layout. Overlapping DOM elements with the fixed R3F canvas behind.
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Extremely generous (py-24 to py-48) to force dramatic scrolling and camera movement.

webgl_3d_strategy.stack: React Three Fiber (R3F) + Drei + GSAP ScrollTrigger
webgl_3d_strategy.post_processing: EffectComposer with Bloom (luminanceThreshold 0.4), Noise/Grain overlay (opacity 0.15), and subtle ChromaticAberration (RGB Shift during fast scroll).
webgl_3d_strategy.lighting: Cinematic Cathedral Lighting. SpotLights with high penumbra casting volumetric rays from top-angles. Deep ambient occlusion (AO). Minimal ambient light.
webgl_3d_strategy.materials: Custom GLSL Shaders blending MeshStandardMaterial with noise for stone/marble textures. Patinated gold accents on edges.
webgl_3d_strategy.camera: PerspectiveCamera positioned low, looking slightly up to emphasize monumental scale.
webgl_3d_strategy.interactions: Raycasting on religious artifacts. On pointer enter: slow continuous rotation, cursor changes, bloom intensity spikes slightly. On click: GSAP animates camera closer to object.

sections.name: Hero Inmersivo
sections.layout: Fixed 3D Canvas in background. Overlay DOM with massive 'Marcellus' typography vertically centered.
sections.behavior: ScrollTrigger ties window scroll to camera Z-position. Moving forward into the cathedral void. Text fades out via scroll.

sections.name: Catálogo Navegable (Museo 3D)
sections.layout: Asymmetrical grid overlaying the 3D scene. 3D models float at different Z-depths.
sections.behavior: Non-linear layout. As user scrolls, new artifacts drift into view. HTML captions appear next to the active 3D object using Drei's <Html> component.

sections.name: Detalle de Obra (Narrativa)
sections.layout: Split screen or heavy negative space. 3D object locked on one side (rotating), elegant 'Cormorant' typography scrolling on the other.
sections.behavior: Cinematic easing using GSAP 'Power4.easeInOut' when transitioning into detail view.

sections.name: Formulario de Pedido/Contacto
sections.layout: Brutalist block centered on screen. Dark surfaces with 1px gold/dim borders. Monospaced or clean sans input fields.
sections.components: Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea. Customized with 'bg-transparent border-b border-border_dim rounded-none focus:border-primary_accent'.

sections.name: Footer Monumental
sections.layout: Massive padding. A gigantic brand mark or typography spanning 100vw, with tiny technical/contact links at the bottom.
sections.behavior: Revealed from behind the main content (sticky bottom z-[-1]).

micro_interactions.buttons: Dark stone background. On hover: subtle gold border tracing (Aceternity tracing beam style) or text color shift to gold.
micro_interactions.cursor: Custom dot cursor that expands into a ring over clickable 3D objects or 2D links.
micro_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll mandatory for weighty, momentum-based scrolling. Heavy damping for a 'heavy stone' feel.

textures.description: Black marble with white veins, ideal for base floor or object shaders.
Close-up dark Carnico marble surface for wall textures or brutalist UI blocks.

artworks.description: Marble bust of Jesus wearing a crown of thorns (use as texture mapped onto a 3D plane or as a standalone 2D hero image if 3D model unavailable).
Close-up of detailed stone sculpture of Christ.
Mosaic of the Virgin Mary in a golden background. Can be used as a texture for an altar or wall piece.
Orthodox church interior. Can be used as a blurry background map (Environment) for realistic reflections in 3D materials.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, forms, links, and 3D Html overlays MUST use data-testid (e.g., data-testid='contact-form-submit', data-testid='catalog-item-christ').
